title: Triage
description: Handoff from the triage stage. Decides whether an issue is clear enough for an unattended agent to build.

actionable.description: true only if the issue states a concrete, testable outcome that can be built without asking anyone

reason.description: One sentence explaining the decision. For non-actionable issues, say what is missing.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The concrete, testable outcomes the worker must deliver. Empty when not actionable.
